content:
# Checks `main` after each merge to ensure package metadata, documentation, and
# the CI runtime matrix still agree. It reports policy drift without adding
# another pull-request check or changing normal CI behavior.
name: Node.js support policy

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  policy:
    timeout-minutes: 5
    name: Node.js support policy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'

      - name: Check Node.js support policy
        run: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-node-version-policy.ts
